result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalk markings and a basic sidewalk network in a residential setting. However, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signal heads or traffic calming measures increase exposure for people crossing.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection that appears hostile to pedestrians due to a lack of visible sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. The large crossing distance and high-speed road geometry prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without the protection of a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks and marked crossings forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved shoulders.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear in the asphalt surface create tripping hazards and uneven footing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals with countdown timers to all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Construct Sidewalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Build a continuous paved sidewalk network with ADA-compliant curb ramps at every corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, signalized intersection with multiple travel lanes and marked continental-style crosswalks. While pedestrian signals and sidewalks are present, the long crossing distance and lack of median refuges increase exposure risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Intense sun glare may significantly reduce driver visibility of pedestrians, especially those crossing from the right side of the image.
hazards.location_in_image: Upper right quadrant of the image

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten the crossing distance and reduce the speed of turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and paved sidewalks in a residential setting. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic signals are present, there is a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads and the crossing distance is relatively wide for a residential area.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to uncertainty for pedestrians regarding when it is safe to cross.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Placement
hazards.description: A large utility pole is positioned very close to the curb ramp, which may slightly restrict the effective width of the pedestrian path for those with mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner near the curb ramp
